questionText: In a Star network topology, all client workstation nodes are connected directly to:

options.text: A single shared linear backbone coaxial bus cable
A central network hub, switch, or router
Each other in a closed unidirectional circular ring
Every single other node via dedicated point-to-point links (full mesh)

detailedSolution:

Hence, Option (B) is the correct answer.
